hero.headline: Risk, Audit & Compliance Leader for Multinationals & INGOs
hero.subheadline: 15+ years building risk-based audit functions across 25+ countries — now leading the AI pilot at an INGO reshaping what institutional assurance looks like.

about.short: Internal Audit Leader with 15+ years of risk-based audit, governance, and enterprise risk management experience across INGOs, global corporates, and financial institutions spanning 25+ countries across Africa, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the Americas.
long: I'm an Internal Audit Leader with 15+ years of risk-based audit, governance, and enterprise risk management experience across INGOs, global corporates, and financial institutions spanning 25+ countries across Africa, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the Americas.

I currently serve as Global Lead, Internal Audit at Living Goods International, reporting directly to the Board Finance & Audit Committee across a four-country INGO operation. Before that, I spent five years at SGS as Regional Senior Auditor, delivering risk-based assurance across 25+ countries as part of the world's largest inspection, verification, testing, and certification company — and four years as Chief Audit & Risk Officer at Longhorn Publishers, a publicly listed group, where I built and led the audit and risk function from the ground up.

Beyond audit, I coordinate cross-institutional initiatives — including leading Living Goods' AI pilot as AI Working Group Co-Lead, and supporting the organisation's strategic planning process during a leadership transition. That work reflects how I try to operate: as an institutional leader, not just a technical auditor.
I hold an MBA in Finance, a CIA, and a CPA(K), and I bring a track record of building audit functions that earn genuine institutional trust — not just compliance checkboxes.
